model_annotation: This plot illustrates the dependency between trajectory length and $\gamma$ across three categories: Unsuccessful, All, and Successful. The x-axis, labeled "$\gamma$", features a linear scale without specified units; its numeric tick labels range from 0.86 to 1.00 in regular increments of 0.02. The y-axis, labeled "Trajectory length", utilizes a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 10 to 22 at intervals of 2. The plot contains three dashed lines, each featuring circular markers and vertical error bars with horizontal caps at each data point. The "Unsuccessful" category is represented by a red line that demonstrates a continuous upward trend; it begins at an x-value of 0.85 with a y-value of approximately 17.0, rises to 18.7 at x=0.95 and 19.1 at x=0.99, and ends with its sharpest increase at roughly 21.3 at x=1.00. The "All" category is depicted by a blue line that steadily climbs from approximately 15.3 at x=0.85 to 16.9 at x=0.95, reaches 17.1 at x=0.99, and concludes with a distinct rise to roughly 19.2 at x=1.00. The "Successful" category is shown as a green line starting at approximately 10.6 at x=0.85; it increases to 12.6 at x=0.90, progresses moderately to 12.9 at x=0.95 and 13.3 at x=0.99, and finishes with a noticeable upward jump to approximately 15.3 at x=1.00.
